relations.rationale: Nell's past race ranking has no bearing on the group's tiredness or satisfaction with their progress.
Nell's past race ranking is unrelated to the group settling in for the night.
Discussing race bibs is unrelated to the group settling under the stars.
If Zeno was the oldest of the five, it is consistent with and supports the idea that he was only slightly older than Dara, since he could be just a couple years older than the next oldest.
The age gap between Zeno and Dara has no bearing on Dara setting up a camp stove.
The age difference between Zeno and Dara is unrelated to Zeno pointing out a hawk.
The age gap between Zeno and Dara has no bearing on the group settling in for the night.
If Eli is on the same team as Zeno, this does not determine whether Mina is or isn't on that team, as team membership of one person doesn't exclude another's.
The trail leading to a rocky overlook supports the idea that the group could pause there for lunch, since the location is established.
The trail description leading to an overlook is unrelated to reaching the summit shelter at sunset, a separate location and time.
Pausing for lunch at the overlook supports the idea that Dara would set up a stove to prepare food there.
Pausing for lunch supports Nell unpacking sandwiches as part of that lunch stop.
Stopping for lunch at the overlook earlier does not preclude or affect reaching the summit shelter later at sunset.
Setting up a camp stove has no logical connection to clouds rolling in later.
Unpacking sandwiches for lunch is unrelated to the group settling in for the night later.
Clouds rolling in could prompt the group to hasten their pace toward the summit, supporting the decision to speed up.
Clouds rolling in early afternoon is compatible with and could support the group later reaching the summit at sunset, showing continued progress despite weather.
Deciding to pick up pace toward the summit supports the outcome of reaching the summit shelter as the sun set.
Zeno pointing out a hawk directly explains and supports everyone stopping to watch it.
Reaching the summit shelter at sunset supports the group feeling tired but pleased with their progress.
